messages:
maria: Heads-up — planning a base-image rebuild TOMORROW 02:00 UTC. Need RBAC changes for KMS signer + build-runner, and increase audit log retention for image push/sign events. Also one open vuln in libc; may block canary.

devon: Which SAs need changes? CI build-runner? signer-service?

maria: Right: build-runner-SA (push images, sign), signer-SA (cosign via KMS), attestor (staging verifier). Minimal perms:
- build-runner-SA: storage.objects.create/storage.objects.get for staging bucket
- signer-SA: roles/cloudkms.signer (or specific cryptoKeyVersions.signBlob)
- attestor: storage.objects.get, containeranalysis.notes/list

sam: For audit logs: we need Data Access logs for KMS + Admin Activity for GCR. Current retention 30d — compliance wants 90d. Can we bump? :eyes:

ops-bot: Ticket INFRA-1289 created: "image rebuild audit retention increase to 90d" (assignee: devon)

devon: Will do. Also note the canary nodes run with a restricted node pool; they need read access to the signer key or intermediary token. We prefer signer-SA with short-lived signed tokens rather than granting node pool the key directly.

lina: vuln triage update: CVE-2025-9999 (glibc) present in base image layer. Patch exists in distro (2.35.1). If we rebuild without patch it's risky. Recommend we patch in Dockerfile before canary rollout.

maria: Agreed — patch first. Add to rebuild Dockerfile early layer to minimize rebuild churn.

devon: Dockerfile snippet to pin version:
```
FROM ubuntu:22.04
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y libc6=2.35.1-1ubuntu1 && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
```
We'll build a canary image and push to staging registry.

lina: Cosign + KMS notes — we should sign CI artifacts using KMS-backed key. Example:
```
# sign
cosign sign --key gcpkms://projects/myproj/locations/global/keyRings/rebuild/cryptoKeys/cosign-key my-registry/my-image:canary
# verify
cosign verify --key gcpkms://projects/myproj/locations/global/keyRings/rebuild/cryptoKeys/cosign-key my-registry/my-image:canary
```
Make sure the signer-SA has kms.cryptoSign permission.

sam: Security scan report: canary e2e failed with seccomp EPERM on clone3 syscall — runtime profile needs a small allow list. Failing tests are in sandboxed worker only. :lock:

maria: We should add a temporary exception in canary seccomp then fix code if needed. Timeline: patch base image today, push canary by 20:00 UTC, sign with KMS, run canary for 4 hours, then promote if green. Who owns the RBAC change and KMS permissions?

devon: I'll own RBAC (INFRA-1289 + grant roles/cloudkms.signer to signer-SA). I'll PR least-privilege IAM bindings and post link here.

maria: I'll coordinate the rebuild and verify cosign signatures. Lina will handle vuln triage validation. Sam will run runtime seccomp debug.

lina: One more: enable Data Access audit logs for container registry & KMS (project-level). I've got a short runbook for retention changes — will paste in PR.

maria: Great. Reply with :thumbsup: when you have the PR/ticket links and we can lock the window.

devon: PR: github.com/redwood/rebuild-ops/pull/42 — IAM bindings + audit retention change. assigning reviewers.

maria: Awesome. I'll schedule the canary and ping #eng-oncall for the window. Thanks all. :party:

security-bot: Auto-scan: sbom generated, vulnerability note attached to INFRA-1289. Recommend post-build attestation with containeranalysis.

maria: Noted — include attest verify step in CI before canary promotion.
